name: Extortion
overview: Scripture portrays extortion as a grievous sin characterized by greed and oppression, as seen in Ezekiel 22:12 where it condemns those who gain greedily from their neighbors and forget the Lord. The narrative of Jacob demanding Esau's birthright for a mere meal (Genesis 25:31) and Pharaoh's harsh exactions during famine (Genesis 47:13) illustrate instances of exploiting others under desperate circumstances. The Psalms and Isaiah further depict extortioners as destined for judgment and ruin, emphasizing God's opposition to such exploitative behavior and the ultimate end of oppressors who prey upon the vulnerable.
